```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

# install and load packages
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggridges)

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

# read input files with divergence at given times
rate_file_list = list.files("../results/BEAST/", pattern = "*div_[allint]{3}.txt", recursive = T, full.names = T)

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

median_abs_data = tibble(ID = c(NA), Type=c(NA), Branches=c(NA), Median=c(NA))
time_divergence_data = tibble(ID = c(NA), Type=c(NA), Branches=c(NA), Time=c(NA), Divergence=c(NA))

# iterate through each file
for (file in rate_file_list) {
  # extract file name by last index
  filename = str_split(file, "/")[[1]][length(str_split(file, "/")[[1]])]
  
  # extract ID, divergence type and branch set
  ID = str_split(filename, "_")[[1]][1]
  Type = str_split(filename, "_")[[1]][2]
  Branches = gsub(".txt", "", str_split(filename, "_")[[1]][4])
  
  # extract median rates
  if (Branches == "all") {
    median = as.numeric(gsub(";", "", str_split(read_lines(file)[12], " ")[[1]][8]))
  } else if (Branches == "int") {
    median = as.numeric(gsub(";", "", str_split(read_lines(file)[14], " ")[[1]][8]))
  }
  median_abs_data = rbind(median_abs_data, c(ID, Type, Branches, median))
  
  # extract divergence per time estimates
  for (i in 18:length(read_lines(file))) {
    
    currline = read_lines(file)[i]
    time = as.numeric(str_split(currline, "\t")[[1]][1])
    div = as.numeric(str_split(currline, "\t")[[1]][3])
    time_divergence_data = rbind(time_divergence_data, c(ID, Type, Branches, time, div))
  }
}

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

# plot differences between internal and external branches for each type and participant
median_abs_data %>% 
  filter(is.na(ID)==F) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Type, y = as.numeric(Median), fill = Branches, group=interaction(Type, Branches))) + 
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(fill="white", alpha=0.5, position=position_dodge(width=0.9)) +
  geom_point(position=position_dodge(width=0.9)) + 
  theme_test() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Median divergence rate (subst./site/time unit)") +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("All", "Internal")) +
  theme(text=element_text(face="bold", size=12))

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

# plot density plots of divergence rates for identification of groups/clusters
median_abs_data %>% 
  filter(is.na(ID)==F) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(Median), y = Type, fill = Branches)) + 
  geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.5) +
  theme_test() +
  labs(y = "", x = "Median divergence rate (subst./site/time unit)") +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("All", "Internal")) +
  theme(text=element_text(face="bold", size=12))

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

# plot trajectories of divergence over time for all and internal branches, EN and ES rates
time_divergence_data %>% 
  filter(is.na(ID)==F) %>% 
  group_by(ID, Type, Branches) %>% 
  mutate(RealTime = max(as.numeric(Time)) - as.numeric(Time)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=RealTime, y = as.numeric(Divergence), col=interaction(Branches, Type), group=interaction(Branches, Type))) + 
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ID, scales="free") +
  scale_color_discrete("Branches, Type", labels = c("All, E[N]", "Internal, E[N]", "All, E[S]", "Internal, E[S]")) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Median divergence rate") +
  theme_test()

```
